$comment: Copy this file to config/workflow.json and replace every TODO_ value.
Nothing here is a real ExtendedReach selector. The operator supplies them
from the authorised account, using the browser's inspector.
This POC implements exactly ONE report. `reports` is a map so more can be
added later, but the tool refuses to run if more than one is enabled.
The authenticated check is deterministic and reads no page text: it
asks whether a specific element exists. Prefer something that only
appears when signed in, e.g. a sign-out link or the account menu.
$comment_mfa: If any of these match, the run stops and returns requires_human_login.
The tool never fills, clicks, solves or bypasses them.

$comment: Read-only guards. url_denylist_substrings blocks navigation to any URL
that looks like a write action; if the portal uses different words for
these, add them. screenshot_safe_url_substrings is the ONLY set of
pages a failure screenshot may be taken on — keep report pages out of
it, because a screenshot of a report is a screenshot of case data.

TODO_REPORT_SLUG.description: TODO(operator): which report this is, in plain words.

$comment: mode is 'direct_url' or 'steps'. direct_url is preferred: it is one
GET and cannot wander. Use 'steps' only if the report has no stable
URL. EXTENDEDREACH_REPORT_URL in .env overrides both.
Only predefined, non-sensitive filters. `value_env` names the .env
variable holding the value; values are rejected unless they match
^[A-Za-z0-9 _./:-]{1,64}$ so a person's name cannot be typed into
a portal field by this tool.
type is one of: select_option, fill, check, uncheck.
filters.name: date_range

apply_filters_control.$comment: Optional. Omit if filters apply on change.

$comment: The control that starts the download. Give a selector, or a role +
accessible name, or both — selector wins when present.
Note: in this agency's portal the control is labelled 'Excel' even
on reports that download as CSV. The extension is read from the
download itself, never assumed from this label.
export.name: TODO_EXPORT_BUTTON_TEXT

$comment: expected_extension is advisory: the allow-list in .env is what is
enforced. expected_csv_headers_env names the .env variable holding
the required header names.
